title.zh: SDF 发布结论落库（按 criterion v2.2 验证；含边界与证据索引）
title.en: Record the SDF release conclusion (verified under criterion v2.2; boundaries and evidence index)

intent.zh: 把 SDF 发布结论落成证据：在 `sdf-release-v2.2/` 记录发布声明「SDF 渲染能力已按 render-sdf-criterion-v2.2 验证（scene-sdf 参考位级 + scene-a 清单豁免，前提见 v2.2）」；判据要点与数值沿革；窗口执行记录（窗口卡 verified、attempt5 VALID、guards 9e000bfc../37,000 B、aggregate 034c7551../94 条、窗口双签 2026-11-02T08:29:18+08:00、QA verdict 2026-11-02T16:13:11+08:00）；证据索引；边界（参考集 scene-sdf 单场景、豁免清单 183/172、B=128 由精确 replay 定、camera 0 位级、C 类证据不单独作通过依据）；不声明「上游等价/精度达标/渲染数值验收通过」；manifest 自洽。
intent.en: Record the SDF release conclusion in sdf-release-v2.2/: the statement 'SDF rendering capability verified under render-sdf-criterion-v2.2 (scene-sdf reference bitwise + scene-a list exemption; premises see v2.2)'; criterion highlights and numeric lineage; window execution record (window card verified, attempt5 VALID, guards 9e000bfc../37,000 B, aggregate 034c7551../94 entries, window double-sign 2026-11-02T08:29:18+08:00, QA verdict 2026-11-02T16:13:11+08:00); evidence index; boundaries (reference set is the single scene-sdf scene, exemption lists 183/172, B=128 from the exact replay, camera 0 bitwise, C-class evidence never a standalone pass basis); it does not claim upstream equivalence / precision-compliance / render-value acceptance; self-consistent manifest.

acceptance: `sdf-release-v2.2/` 含 README.md（发布声明 + 判据要点 + 窗口执行记录 + 证据索引 + 边界）与 manifest.txt（sha256/bytes 自洽）。
发布口径只写「SDF 渲染能力已按 render-sdf-criterion-v2.2 验证（scene-sdf 参考位级 + scene-a 清单豁免，前提见 v2.2）」；不写「上游等价/精度达标/渲染数值验收通过」；边界写明参考集 scene-sdf 单场景、豁免清单 183/172、B=128 由精确 replay 定、camera 0 位级、C 类证据不单独作通过依据。
证据索引指向 criterion v2.2 spec、窗口卡 receipt（含 qa_verdict）、attempts/attempt5、material v4、attempt1-4 作废归档；零 GPU、不改判据数值/清单/参考/fixtures/src/内核身份。
note: Arch 2026-11-02 注册（attempt5 收口后）。窗口卡 2026-10-31-render-sdf-validate 已 verified；QA verdict 已落库（VALID ROUND，0 阻断/0 需修/2 观察已处理）。本片只落发布结论与证据索引，不声明越界结论。
